bio: Even the route to the magnificent moated castle, a 17C architectural gem, is an experience – you get to this stunning estate through a wooded area, then a bridge over the moat leads into the beautiful inner courtyard. The restaurant allies the character of this site steeped in history with modern comfort and winter garden-style. The view through the large glazed front is fabulous, not to mention the terrace! They serve two 4- or 6-course set menus of modern inspiration – one with meat and its vegetarian counterpart. You can choose the matching wine or non-alcoholic pairing....
